caption: Token Resolution Breakdown for FedHLM: Local, P2P, and LLM Token Distribution.

annotations.annotation: The pie chart titled "Token Routing Distribution (FedHLM)" represents the distribution of token routing across different categories. It includes a total of three slices. The largest slice is labeled "LOCAL," colored green, and constitutes approximately 94.5% of the chart. There are two smaller slices labeled "LLM" and "EDGE_P2P," colored red and blue respectively, representing about 3.9% and 1.6%. The chart includes percentage labels inside each slice, providing a clear indication of their proportions. The slices do not appear to be ordered by size, and none are visually emphasized. There is no additional legend included in the chart.
